name: Playwright Local Isolated MCP
summary: Verify local browser interfaces through an exact Playwright MCP release with isolated state and loopback-only origins.
description: Launches the official Playwright MCP package at an exact npm version with isolated browser state, blocked service workers, and an origin allowlist restricted to the local loopback host.
refuses: It does not browse non-loopback origins, authenticated production sessions, or user browser profiles.
It does not treat allowed origins as a complete security boundary or assume redirects remain in scope.
It does not upload files, persist browser state, or claim an observed journey proves all interface behavior.

mcpServer.trustBoundary: Only unauthenticated loopback browser journeys are in scope; isolated state and blocked service workers reduce persistence, while page content and redirects remain untrusted and must be checked against the explicit origin boundary.
